specification.title: Sufficient evidence stops the investigation immediately
specification.description: Sufficient evidence causes an immediate stop after analysis.
specification.purpose: Verify sufficient evidence triggers an immediate stop after analysis rather than continued exploration.
specification.operational_relevance: Stopping at sufficiency keeps real investigations focused and cheap; unnecessary pivots delay reporting.
specification.regression_risk: The coordinator could continue exploring after sufficient evidence is reached.

forbidden: Provider work continues after sufficient evidence has been reached
